extension.summary: Clear caches, reload PVR, and maintain media libraries
extension.description: Clears Kodi's temporary cache, downloaded installation packages, and data folders from uninstalled add-ons; reloads PVR clients; optionally clears registered textures; and scans and cleans media libraries without restarting Kodi.
extension.news: Move texture cleanup before library scans and add staged maintenance summaries with Delete Textures, Scan Libraries, and Exit choices.
